description: Private, bounded target-mode mutation proposal for SEMM filament-distance consumer behavior. Both source-pinned mutants target actual WipeTower2 consumers and are selected only by the four new public Print cases.

mutants.description: Omit cooling_tube_retraction from the pre-cooling unload distance while leaving the independent park correction unchanged.
mutants.intended_failed_case: Public SEMM cooling tube retraction and park correction conserve the stop distance
mutants.expected_failure_reason: The full Print export must retract center + tube-length/2 before cooling and compensate the center offset on the return to parking.

mutants.description: Treat a negative extra_loading_move as zero instead of shortening the loading distance below the parking distance.
mutants.intended_failed_case: Public SEMM extra loading distance preserves its signed 20/70/10 partition
mutants.expected_failure_reason: The public Print case uses parking 40 mm and extra loading -5 mm, then checks the emitted 20/70/10 phases total 35 mm.
